headlines.headline: DON NELSON, SECOND-WINNINGEST COACH IN NBA HISTORY, DIES AT 86
headlines.detail: Hall of Famer Don Nelson died Sunday, his family confirmed. He won five titles as a Celtics player before becoming the NBA's second-winningest coach ever, notching 250-plus wins with three different franchises while also serving as each team's GM.

headlines.headline: FALCONS' JALON WALKER TEARS ACL IN CAMP, OUT FOR THE SEASON
headlines.detail: Atlanta's 2025 first-round pick tore his ACL during an 11-on-11 camp drill and was carted off, ending his season before it starts after a 5.5-sack rookie year.

headlines.headline: OHIO STATE OPENS NO. 1 IN 2026 PRESEASON COACHES POLL
headlines.detail: The AFCA Coaches Poll tabbed Ohio State No. 1 with 38 first-place votes — the Buckeyes' first preseason coaches' No. 1 since 2015 — ahead of Oregon, Georgia, Texas and Notre Dame.

headlines.headline: COURT INJUNCTION FORCES SURPRISE AUGUST TRANSFER PORTAL WINDOW
headlines.detail: A federal judge's class-wide preliminary injunction is forcing the NCAA to restore a fifth season of eligibility to players who exhausted it this spring, triggering a surprise Aug. 3-10 transfer window that caught coaches off guard.
